description.purpose: The documented Bosch drain-pump clean, end to end. E:18 points at "Cleaning the drain pump" (page 28). Passing requires the manual's own order - drain attempt, tap off, unplug, cool, open, pre-drain, clean, impeller, refit, film, cover.
description.notes: Paired with ac_01b, which is the same machine and the same blockage plus a burning smell, and must stop before step 1. Skipping the cooling step scalds the customer; skipping the pre-drain floods the floor; leaving the cover off is a water-damage risk the manual warns about. Each is caught by a separate assertion.
